question: Which parts of LINE sticker support should OpenClaw accept in the bundled LINE plugin now: send-only channelData/directive support, inbound packageId/stickerId metadata, a shared cross-channel sticker abstraction, or none until a narrower PR is sponsored?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the original proposal crosses product boundaries between bundled channel behavior, core reply payload shape, and ClawHub-owned skill/catalog content.

options.title: Sponsor focused LINE send path
options.body: Accept a narrow LINE-plugin implementation using channelData.line.sticker and a LINE-owned directive, while leaving inbound metadata and catalogs as follow-ups.

options.title: Bundle broader send and receive support
options.body: Accept send plus inbound structured metadata now, with explicit review of any core reply-pipeline or SDK contract changes before merge.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub/plugin work
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and ask contributors to publish catalog/editor behavior externally until a missing plugin API is identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused LINE send path
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow LINE-plugin implementation using channelData.line.sticker and a LINE-owned directive, while leaving inbound metadata and catalogs as follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has strong recent history on the plugin/channel seam and product-boundary refactors relevant to deciding bundled versus ClawHub scope.
